# OpenEdition Journals

> A scholarly journal platform implementing advanced bot protection and anti-scraping measures using Proof-of-Work challenges and Hashcash verification.

OpenEdition Journals hosts peer-reviewed academic journals across multiple disciplines. The platform uses Anubis-based Proof-of-Work challenges with Hashcash to protect against automated access and web scraping while maintaining legitimate user access.

## Key Topics

- Anubis
- Hashcash
- Proof-of-Work
- Bot Protection
- Anti-Scraping
- Challenge Verification
- JavaScript Challenge
- Website Security
- CAPTCHA Alternative
- Server Security
- Web Scraping Defense
- Anti-Spam
- JShelter
- Headless Browsers
